prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a person’s hands, with one hand gently applying cream to the back of the other. The skin appears smooth and well-cared-for, with natural, healthy tones. Overlaid on the skin are semi-transparent, softly glowing hexagonal icons labeled “B5,” suggesting a scientific or dermatological focus on vitamin B5. The background is softly blurred, featuring cool, neutral tones—primarily whites and pale blues—evoking a clean, clinical, and modern environment. The lighting is soft and diffuse, eliminating harsh shadows and highlighting the natural texture and sheen of the skin. The overall style is minimalistic and contemporary, with a focus on clarity and a sense of gentle care, reminiscent of high-end skincare advertisements or medical product demonstrations. The camera angle is directly above the hands, creating an intimate and focused composition with shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the interaction between the hands and the digital overlay.
